query: set up a pricing policy so my preemptible h100 jobs never pay more than 3.50 per gpu hour
expected_behavior: Uses nebius billing pricing-policy create with --compute-instance-spec-v1-platform gpu-h100-sxm and --pricing-max-price-v1-max-price 3.500 (per-GPU hourly USD, decimal string)
Treats create as Tier B: prints the resolved command, states the bid and what it caps, waits for explicit confirmation, runs once
Warns that a bid below the current spot price is accepted but starts SCHEDULING_STATE_BLOCKED and backs no VM until the market drops
Notes the policy is per-platform (this one caps gpu-h100-sxm only) and that it is used at launch via --spot-pricing-policy-id
Points to nebius-serverless-jobs/-endpoints for the actual gated launch
